### Can Evil Be Restrained?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-8-2023.html
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 2:9-10
Points:
- The church currently acts as salt and light to curb spiritual decay and darkness.
- Worldly culture often resents Bible-believing Christians as obstacles to human progress.
- Once the restraining presence is removed, unrestrained deception and evil will flood the world.
- Contemplating God's coming judgment should create urgent compassion to share the gospel.

### Power Point - November 1, 2005
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-november-1-2005-1360142.html
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 2:9-12
Points:
- Deceptive modern spiritual trends are not new but stem from satanic deception.
- Those who reject the truth become vulnerable to powerful delusions and falsehoods.
- Believers urgently need biblical discernment grounded in the wisdom of Scripture.
- Christians must reject spiritual retreat and model holy lives that display God's truth.
